title: Standard return window
text: Standard returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery when the item is unused and includes the original packaging.

title: Holiday return exception
text: Items purchased during December may be returned within 30 days of delivery unless the item is marked final sale.

title: Defective item return
text: A defective item may be returned within 45 days of delivery. Customers should include a short description of the defect.

title: Final sale items
text: Items marked final sale are not eligible for a standard return unless the product is defective or the wrong item was shipped.

title: Refund processing time
text: Approved refunds are normally returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is inspected.

title: Standard shipping
text: Standard shipping normally arrives within 3 to 5 business days after the order leaves the warehouse.

title: Expedited shipping
text: Expedited shipping normally arrives within 1 to 2 business days after the order leaves the warehouse. Remote areas may take longer.

title: Tracking information
text: Tracking information is added to the customer account and sent by email after the carrier accepts the package.

title: Lost package review
text: If tracking has not changed for 5 business days after the expected delivery date, support can open a lost-package review with the carrier.

title: Address changes
text: A shipping address can be changed only before the warehouse begins fulfillment. After fulfillment starts, support cannot guarantee an address change.

title: Limited warranty
text: Eligible products include a 12-month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.

title: Shipping damage
text: Visible shipping damage should be reported within 7 days of delivery with photos of the item and outer packaging.

title: Password reset
text: Customers can request a password-reset link from the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor authentication can be enabled from account security settings. Recovery codes should be stored in a secure location.

title: Invoice access
text: Invoices are available from the billing section of the customer account after payment is completed.

title: Subscription cancellation
text: A subscription can be cancelled before the next renewal date. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not automatically refund the current billing period.

title: Data deletion request
text: A verified data-deletion request is normally completed within 30 days unless retention is required for legal or security reasons.

title: Support hours
text: Live support is available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time, excluding company holidays.

title: Import duties
text: International customers are responsible for import duties, taxes, and customs fees charged by the destination country unless the checkout page explicitly states otherwise.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash except where required by law.
